metricas_clave: Earnings Growth: For Q3 2026, the estimated (year-over-year) earnings growth rate for the S&P 500 is 29.6%. If 29.6% is the actual growth rate for the quarter, it will mark the third-straight quarter of earnings growth above 2 5% for the index.

Earnings Revisions: On June 30, the estimated (year-over-year) earnings growth rate for the S&P 500 for Q 3 2026 was 26.7%. Four sectors are expected to report higher earnings today (compared to June 30) due to upward revisions to EPS estimates.
Earnings Guidance: For Q3 2026, 44 S&P 500 companies have issued negative EPS guidance and 72 S&P 500 companies have issued positive EPS guidance.
Valuation: The forward 12 -month P/E ratio for the S&P 500 is 19.1. This P/E ratio is below the 5-year average (19.8) but equal to the 10-year average (19.1).

Earnings Scorecard: For Q3 2026 (with 19 S&P 500 companies reporting actual results), 16 S&P 500 companies have reported a positive EPS surprise and 14 S&P 500 companies has reported a positive revenue surprise.
beneficios.frase_bpa_bottom_up: The Q3 bottom-up EPS estimate (which is an aggregation of the median Q 3 earnings estimates for all 500 companies in the index and can be used as a proxy for the earnings of the index) increased by 1.4% (to $89.86 from $88.64) from June 30 to September 30.

evidencia.nota: Mismas reglas cada viernes desde 2003 con la información publicada en cada fecha (sin FedWatch: 6 de 7 condiciones). Ventanas solapadas; descriptivo, no causal.

consumo_xly_xlp.nota: Ratio de precios XLY/XLP (Yahoo Finance, ajustado por splits, sin dividendos: igual que TradingView) cada viernes; S&P 500 = Cboe SPX. Medianas (y media a 13 semanas). Consumo real = ventas minoristas reales (FRED RRSFS), media 3 meses vs 3 anteriores, disponible con 50 días de desfase; valores finales (sin vintages). Ventanas solapadas: descriptivo, no causal.
